name: Rude Awakening is offered by Undertaker Mordo to a non-Undead Horde character who arrived by Travel Permit (#6295)
contract: Report #6295: after using the Travel Permit to reach Tirisfal Glades, a non-Undead Horde character is not offered 'Rude Awakening' by Undertaker Mordo.
quest_template 363 'Rude Awakening' has AllowableRaces 690 (Orc, Undead, Tauren, Troll, Blood Elf), no previous quest, class limit or conditions, and Mordo (1568) is its starter.
The Travel Permit (src/server/coa/AscensionTravelPermit.cpp) only teleports the caster to the destination's start point; it changes no quest state.
So an Orc who travels by permit to Tirisfal Glades must be offered and able to take the quest from the spawned Mordo, and so must the other Horde races that can take it.

steps.label: The Orc receives a Travel Permit
